label: Access
name: access
description: Who is calling and what they may do, as a tree another tree includes: two sign-in routes (customers, employees) that both end in this tree's own token, refresh and sign-out, preferences kept in the session, the policies other features gate their triggers with, and the command that gives a challenge its code. The host binds identity.port.json to its directories and configures the @auth plugin as below; on its own, access-dev binds it to the directories written in connections/ so this tree checks, rehearses and runs alone.

otp.description: a one-time code: printed by the issue-otp command in this example, delivered out of band in a real tree -- the binding of access.port.json#deliverCode decides

startup.label: Listen
startup.description: Open the port and answer this tree's routes, for a run of this tree alone.
